summary.headline: Sambhv Q2 FY27 revenue INR840 crore, EBITDA INR105 crore (>12% margin), PAT INR61 crore; FY27 EBITDA/ton guided at INR8,000-8,500.
summary.overview: Management reported Q2 FY27 revenue of INR840 crore, EBITDA of INR105 crore, PAT of INR61 crore and operating cash flow of INR213 crore, with value-added sales volume up 27% YoY. EBITDA per ton fell from about INR8,800 in Q1 to about INR8,200 in Q2, attributed to monsoon-related raw material yield losses, stainless steel margin compression from Chinese 200/300 series dumping after QCO relaxation, and normalising Q1 prices. Management raised its FY27 EBITDA/ton bracket to INR8,000-8,500 and announced a seamless stainless steel pipe project (INR150 crore, 14,400 tpa, production by March 2028). Working capital days fell to 4-5, which management said is not sustainable versus a 20-25 day norm.

segments.name: MS pipes and tubes
segments.commentary: Largest contributor to volume growth in Q2; EBITDA per ton cited at about INR9,000. Q2 realisation about INR60-61/kg-equivalent per management, guided to INR63-64 for Q3.

segments.name: Galvanised / coated products
segments.commentary: EBITDA per ton cited at about INR7,000. Q3 realisation guided at INR78-79 for GP coil and pipe, versus INR72-73 in Q2.

segments.name: Stainless steel (flat/coil)
segments.commentary: Production about 5,000-5,500 tons per month; EBITDA about INR12,000-13,000 per ton, down from Q1 due to Chinese dumping. Mix about 90% 200 series and 10% 300 series. Q2 volumes cited as 130,000 tons (200 series) and 230,000 tons (300 series).

segments.name: Seamless stainless steel pipes (new)
segments.commentary: Planned 14,400 tpa piercing and pilgering plant, INR150 crore capex, production expected by March 2028. Management targets about 10,000 tons by FY30 and an EBITDA of INR60-70 crore at steady state.

guidance_outlook: FY27 value-added product sales target 4.10-4.25 lakh tons: over 2.4 lakh tons MS pipes and tubes, 1.10-1.20 lakh tons galvanised, 50,000-60,000 tons stainless steel coil.
FY27 EBITDA per ton bracket raised to INR8,000-8,500.
FY27 total sales including Kesda about 5.5 lakh tons; EBITDA upward of INR550 crore. FY28 about 7 lakh tons and EBITDA upward of INR750 crore (volume and EBITDA targets as stated on the call).
Stainless steel Kesda plant (360,000 tpa, with 25 MW power) to be live by March 2027; first-year utilisation 30-35%, 60-65% by FY29.
30 MW Sarora captive power plant (INR150 crore) live by September 2027, saving INR60-70 crore minimum; DFT pipe expansion 3.5 to 5 lakh tons by September 2027.
Net debt to operating EBITDA expected to rise to about 1.4-1.5x during capex cycle; company aims to hold about 1.04x for full FY27.
Targets 2.5-3% EBITDA margin accretion by 2030 from captive power and cost initiatives; captive power saves INR1,000-1,500 per ton.
Phase 2 and 3 capex estimated INR1,500-2,000 crore including power; company will confirm after Kesda goes live, and seamless expansion of about INR400 crore by FY31 is an aspiration.
capex_capacity: Vision 2030: scale finished product capacity from 0.6 million tons to over 2 million tons; 90% of energy from captive power by 2030.
Kesda stainless steel integrated facility: 360,000 tpa, live by March 2027, on track per management.
Seamless stainless steel pipe plant: INR150 crore, 14,400 tpa, piercing and pilgering, live by March 2028; approvals and land acquisition in final stage; INR25 crore warrant proceeds received.
Seamless utilisation: about 30% in FY29 and 60-65% in FY30. Working capital needs of INR50-60 crore in FY29 and up to INR80-90 crore by FY30.
Stainless steel operating at about 60% utilisation currently; mostly thinner-gauge output below 0.9 mm.
demand_pricing: Q2 MS pipe realisation about INR60-61; Q3 guided at INR63-64 as coil prices are elevated.
Q2 GP coil and pipe realisation about INR72-73; Q3 guided at INR78-79.
Stainless steel prices stable in Q3 per management, with 200 series price flat and 300 series price flat.
Chinese 200 and 300 series imports dumped below cost after QCO relaxation; management expects government action (minimum import price, anti-dumping) possibly by March 2027.
Seamless: domestic 2-3 lakh tpa documented demand; above 6-inch seamless about 90% imported; PLI 1.2 MoU signed with about 13% of revenue expected as incentive.
Stainless steel distributors and traders destocked in Q2 ahead of price rises; management said Q2 volume was partly pulled forward and Q3 volume will be capped at Q1 levels.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the EBITDA/ton fall from Q1 to Q2 came from mix versus price and cost?
qa_highlights.answer: Management attributed the roughly INR600/ton fall to monsoon raw material yield losses, stainless steel margin compression of 12,000-13,000 tons per annum from QCO relaxation and Chinese dumping, and normalising Q1 war-driven price spikes. Q1 was described as an outlier.

qa_highlights.question: Is the seamless plant's EBITDA per ton and return on capital sound?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited 304 realisation of INR350-360/ton with INR50-55 margin and 316 realisation above INR450/ton with INR80-90 margin. It estimated about 15-16% normal EBITDA margin and INR60-70 crore EBITDA at about 10,000 tons; ROCE estimate was above 24-25%.

qa_highlights.question: Will the Kesda stainless expansion be sold at a discount to imports?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the 10% PLI incentive lets it undercut prices and cited export premiums of 10-15% for competitors. It said first sales will be to replacement and trader markets that need no OEM approval, with OEM approvals expected within 1-2 years of production.

qa_highlights.question: Will the Q2 operating performance continue into Q3 and Q4?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the stainless steel margin of INR12,000-13,000/ton is sustainable with imports already in the market. It said Q3 capacity utilisation cannot rise above Q2, and volume is capped at Q1 levels because of distributor destocking.

qa_highlights.question: Are working capital days of 4-5 sustainable?
qa_highlights.answer: The CFO said the improvement reflected one-time destocking, faster customer recoveries and better supplier credit. She said 20-25 days is the optimum level for the company and the industry.

risks_watch: Chinese 200/300 series dumping and the QCO relaxation pressure stainless steel margins; government action is pending (minimum import price, anti-dumping, possibly by March 2027).
Seamless project execution: OEM and critical approvals, ramp-up to 30% utilisation in FY29, and 6-8 month customer wait times are assumptions still to be proven.
Net debt to operating EBITDA rising to 1.4-1.5x during capex; funding of the INR400 crore subsidiary plan is about 50% internal accruals and 50% debt or equity.
Working capital days of 4-5 are flagged by management as unlikely to hold; a reversion to 20-25 days would absorb cash.
Raw material supply for stainless (nickel substitutes, imported high-value alloys, nickel pig iron) and Middle East-related shipping disruption, though management says supply is currently adequate.
Q3 volumes capped at Q1 levels after destocking and realisations guided up on elevated coil prices.
summary.management_tone: Confident on margins and the expansion timeline, with the seamless plant described as on track. Cautious on Q3 volume, which management tied to destocking, and evasive on Phase 2/3 capex details, which it said will be confirmed after Kesda goes live.

So, we are now in the era of nineties where you have to book a scooter and you have to wait for six months to get a scooter.

adds.what: 360,000 tpa Kesda stainless steel integrated facility (with 25 MW power)
30 MW Sarora captive power plant (INR150 crore)
DFT pipe expansion from 3.5 to 5 lakh tons by September 2027
14,400 tpa seamless stainless steel pipe plant (INR150 crore)

growth.why: FY27 value-added volume aspired at 4.10-4.25 lakh t and FY27 EBITDA/ton raised to INR8,000-8,500, backed by Kesda 3.6 lakh t stainless plant (due March 2027), DFT expansion to 5 lakh t by September 2027 and captive power, though Q3 stainless volume is capped at Q1 levels and destocking pulled volume into Q2.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: FY27 EBITDA/ton raised to INR8,000-8,500 but Q2 fell to about INR8,200 from about INR8,800 in Q1, with stainless margin compressed to INR12,000-13,000/ton by Chinese dumping; Q3 realisations guided up to INR63-64 (MS) and INR78-79 (GP) and captive power saves INR1,000-1,500/ton, but dumping and the 2.5-3% accretion target only arrives by 2030.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Kesda 360,000 tpa stainless plant is under construction for March 2027, DFT pipe expansion from 3.5 to 5 lakh tons by September 2027 and 30 MW Sarora captive power by September 2027 are all under way; seamless 14,400 tpa plant is approved for March 2028.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: FY27 value-added volume aspired at 4.10-4.25 lakh tons and FY28 about 7 lakh tons total, with value-added volume already up 27% YoY in Q2, but Q3 stainless volume is capped at Q1 levels after distributor destocking and Q3 utilisation cannot exceed Q2.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Stainless utilisation is about 60% and Phase 2/3 capex of INR1,500-2,000 crore including power is estimated, with management to confirm after Kesda goes live; Vision 2030 targets 2 million tons from 0.6 million tons.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: FY27 EBITDA/ton bracket was already raised to INR8,000-8,500 and FY28 EBITDA is guided upward of INR750 crore, but the Q2 fall and Q3 volume cap limit near-term upside.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Stainless margins of INR12,000-13,000/ton are exposed to Chinese 200/300 series dumping, government action is pending only by March 2027, and working capital days of 4-5 are unsustainable versus 20-25 days, which would absorb cash.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: The seamless stainless pipe plant (14,400 tpa) is not due until March 2028, so no new product launch is firmly dated inside the window beyond Kesda stainless flat/coil.

rows.label: Government action on Chinese stainless imports (MIP / anti-dumping)
rows.why: Management expects action possibly by March 2027 after Chinese 200/300 series were dumped below cost, which would support the INR12,000-13,000/ton stainless margin that is currently compressed.

rows.label: Working capital days normalise from 4-5 to 20-25
rows.why: CFO said 4-5 days reflects one-time destocking and faster recoveries, and 20-25 days is the optimum, so cash absorption is likely as days revert.

rows.label: Net debt to operating EBITDA rises to 1.4-1.5x in FY27
rows.why: Net debt/EBITDA is about 1.04x in H1 but management guides it up to 1.4-1.5x during the capex cycle, with the INR400 crore subsidiary plan 50% debt or equity funded.

tone.note: Management was confident on the Kesda, DFT and captive power timelines and on the stainless margin holding with imports in the market, but cautious on Q3 volume capped by destocking and evasive on Phase 2/3 capex, which it deferred until after Kesda goes live; analysts pressed on the Q1-to-Q2 EBITDA
